question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

6, ?, 7, 10, 8, 11
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2876be1635d0ca6ba54a15728acc8f3fb1639792bd5e83525afaf6014249361.png]
